sections.content:
118,005 people

were counted on the census as "painters and decorators" in England and Wales in March 2021.

Those working in this unit group apply paint, varnish, wallpaper and other protective and decorative materials to interior and exterior walls and surfaces, paint designs on wood, glass, metal, plastics and other materials, and stain, wax and French polish wood surfaces by hand.

More men than women had this job

Among people working as "painters and decorators" there were more men than women (93.2% compared with 6.8%).

This means "painters and decorators" had a similar proportion of men and women compared with the wider occupation group it falls within of "skilled construction and building trades".

Men made up 93.2% and women made up 6.8% of "painters and decorators"
Across the whole working population, 52% were men and 48% were women.

Other jobs that had a similar proportion of men and women to "painters and decorators" included:

  • mechanical engineers
  • refuse and salvage occupations
  • computer system and equipment installers and servicers

These are the occupations for which the proportion of men and women was most equally split:

  • quality assurance and regulatory professionals
  • chartered and certified accountants
  • conservation professionals

People who had this job were generally older

The occupation of "painters and decorators" had an older age profile compared with the whole working population.

The largest age group of people who had this job were those aged 55 to 59 years. Of the whole working population 10.4% were aged 55 to 59 years. For people working as "painters and decorators", 15.6% were in this age group.

The age group with the smallest proportion of people working as "painters and decorators" was 16 to 19 years.

sections.content:
Other jobs that had a similar age profile to "painters and decorators" included:

  • electrical service and maintenance mechanics and repairers
  • parking and civil enforcement occupations
  • housekeepers and related occupations

Select your age group to see the ten most popular occupations for your age

We can look at who worked as "painters and decorators" by age group and for men and women at the same time to see how these two factors interact.

Among those aged 50 years and older, we see there is a higher proportion of men with this occupation than women.

The percentage of men and women who are "painters and decorators" across age groups

How many people do this job by disability status, employment type and area

Of people working as "painters and decorators", 9% were disabled. This means people said they had a long-term condition that limited them "a little" or "a lot" in their day-to-day activities. The average for all occupations is 9.6%.

Disability is more common among people who are older. This occupation had an older age profile compared with the whole working population.

People with this job were more likely to work full-time than part-time (74.4% compared with 25.6%).

They are also more likely to be self-employed (77.8%) than an employee (22.2%).

The region of England and Wales with the highest percentage of people with this job was London. At a local level, the areas with the highest percentage of people in this occupation included Birmingham, this is in the region of the West Midlands.
